claims.statement: EEG-BIDS standardizes EEG files and metadata, including channel status, for reusable datasets.
A 2026 study achieved strong artifact-specific results on standardized 250 Hz, 22-channel clinical EEG, but did not establish cross-device generalization.
The TUH EEG program states that its corpus may be used for research and commercialization, so initial training rights are obtainable.
Free toolchains and established EEG vendors already provide artifact detection or reduction, so generic cleaning is not a defensible paid wedge.
EU software qualification follows intended purpose; a medical-purpose or device-influencing module may enter MDR or IVDR scope even if cloud-hosted or embedded.
Identifiable clinical EEG is health data under GDPR and requires an Article 9 condition and safeguards.

contrary_evidence: BIDS already has a free validator for structural compliance; it does not create a metadata-validation moat.
EEGLAB, MNE, BrainVision Analyzer, and Persyst cover substantial artifact workflows already.
Persyst says its software is integrated with every major EEG manufacturer, raising the OEM distribution barrier.

economics.acquisition_route: Start with one neuroscience CRO or research-data platform integration; pursue device OEMs only after external cross-device validation. Incumbent integrations make this unvalidated.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: High-uncertainty path: 70 accounts at 8000 PLN monthly revenue equals 6.72 million PLN ARR; 25% EBITDA at 4x and 80% founder ownership implies about 5.38 million PLN founder equity in years 7-9, excluding distributions and retained cash.
economics.founder_time: Three to four founder hours daily for modeling, integrations, and asynchronous technical sales; contract EEG experts for bounded labeling and validation.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Inference: 70-85% after inference, storage, expert adjudication batches, security, and integration support; no customer cost data validates this.
economics.payback: Unknown. A 30000 PLN integration plus 6000 PLN monthly minimum pays back inside 12 months only if it replaces a recurring QC bottleneck; buyer labor savings are unmeasured.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 20000-50000 PLN integration, 3000-8000 PLN monthly minimum, and 2-5 PLN per recording; free substitutes constrain pricing.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every new recording and protocol release repeats QC, while accepted human overrides and benchmark history increase switching cost.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Contractually consented expert corrections and benchmark outcomes across hardware, montages, and protocols improve calibration and auditability
fingerprint.customer: Neuroscience CROs, high-throughput research laboratories, EEG data platforms, and later EEG device vendors
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: CRO pipeline and research-platform integrations first, followed by validated embedded SDK distribution
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Research-use-only artifact scoring and provenance API sold through integration fees, platform minimums, and recording usage
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The CRO, platform, laboratory, or vendor pays when a recording receives a protocol-bound QC result
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A research recording must pass documented quality control before analysis, sponsor delivery, or dataset release

founder_fit: Directly uses the founder's EEG, neuroscience, data-science, and AI background.
A bounded RUO pilot fits the founder's capital and part-time schedule better than a clinical device launch.
Technical integrations and asynchronous evidence-led sales reduce dependence on camera exposure or constant networking.
risks: Cross-device false negatives or false positives could invalidate the acceptance gate.
RUO positioning fails if claims or integrations serve a medical purpose under MDR or IVDR.
Patient EEG and expert corrections require lawful processing, security, and contractual reuse rights.
Incumbent and open-source substitutes may prevent the assumed price or OEM access.

structure.control_point: The auditable acceptance gate before an EEG recording enters analysis or a released research dataset
structure.critical_dependency: Independent cross-device validation plus explicit rights to use customer recordings and expert corrections

thesis: Provide a research-use-only EEG QC and provenance API that standardizes inputs, flags protocol-specific artifact windows, and records human overrides. The paid value must be cross-device benchmarking and auditability, not generic artifact removal already available from free tools and incumbents.
title: NeuroQC Recording Gate API
uncertainties: Cross-device and cross-protocol sensitivity, specificity, and calibration are unvalidated.
No evidence establishes buyer willingness to pay, integration cycle length, or recording volume.
Rights to reuse customer corrections for model improvement require contract-by-contract proof.
The RUO boundary needs regulatory review for each intended use and integration.
